title: Thegidi
desc: Vetri, a criminology student, joins a private detective agency and is tasked with gathering information on three people. However, his subjects mysteriously begin to die one by one.

title: Maanagaram
desc: Upon moving to Chennai, four lives get intertwined as they strive to achieve success in the city. However, when a vicious gangster threatens them, the group must work together to defeat him.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Kullanari Koottam
desc: Vetri, an unemployed young man, meets Priya and falls in love with her, but faces challenges when her father wants him to join the police force.

title: Aamaa Part 2
desc: Mohini and Harsha relocate to a different city to escape the haunting of an evil spirit only to later realize that the spirit is still hot on their trail.

title: Sivanudukkai
desc: A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.

title: Super Hero
desc: After purchasing hair oil, an aspiring actor instead receives a firearm. However, things take a turn when he attempts to get rid of it, but becomes part of a sinister ploy.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Run Run Run
desc: An unemployed computer engineer finds himself indebted to a ruthless money lender. However, things take a turn when he is robbed on his way to pay off his debts.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Teddy
desc: Srividya, a young woman, is put in a coma by corrupt doctors. However, her spirit enters a teddy bear and seeks out a lonely man named Shiva to uncover medical crimes.

title: Shadow
desc: Raghuram, a journalist, exposes the criminal activities of an infamous gangster, who later murders him as revenge. Years later, Rajaram, Raghuram's son, decides to track down the killer.

title: Vikram
desc: A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.
